_comment: CEO Orchestration - USER ceremony settings. GENERATED FILE, do not hand-edit: every hook registration, env key and top-level value below is DERIVED from templates/settings/settings.base.json by .claude/scripts/gen-settings-user-template.py, applying the subtraction declared in the `_derivation` key of this same file. To change what the user profile carries, edit `_derivation` and re-run the generator with --write; CI re-runs it with --check and reddens on any drift. The rule the exclusions follow is stated once, in `_derivation.criterion`, and every excluded hook carries its own class, reason and evidence. Retained entries are byte-identical to the base template, including their `_comment` annotations, except where `_derivation.matcher_overrides` or `_derivation.annotation_overrides` declares a difference and says why. All hook FILES are still copied to disk by install.sh, so validate-governance.sh REQUIRED_FILES stay satisfied; an omitted hook is simply never registered, and is therefore dormant for the no-GPG user profile.

_derivation._comment: PLAN-169 wave-s330-F (OQ-E5). THE SUBTRACTION, AS DATA. This object is the only place that says what the USER ceremony profile removes from templates/settings/settings.base.json; .claude/scripts/gen-settings-user-template.py is the only mechanism that applies it, and its --check mode is re-run by the test suite. It replaces a prose claim that had rotted: the frozen copy said it removed "exactly 10" hooks and kept every retained entry byte-identical in its behavioural fields, while the S330 census measured 26 removed basenames, one hand-narrowed matcher, one silently dropped second registration, three hand-edited _comment annotations and one hand-edited statusMessage. The per-hook audit behind every verdict below is .claude/plans/PLAN-169/s330-ceremony-F/hook-classification-S330.md.
_derivation.criterion: Regra de EXCLUSAO aplicada aos 26 hooks que a base registra e o perfil user nao registrava (classificacao S330). NAO e uma caracterizacao do perfil inteiro: o perfil registra hooks bloqueantes desde a v1.0.0 por decisoes anteriores a esta wave. Fica de fora todo hook que (a) bloqueia uma chamada de ferramenta sem deixar ao adopter uma rota praticavel — modo advisory, kill-switch, ou uma forma alternativa do proprio comando —, (b) exige infraestrutura de cerimonia que --ceremony user nao instala, ou (c) observa/reforca um rito de mantenedor cuja metade enforcing o perfil nao registra. Todo hook que esta wave ACRESCENTA e que ainda pode bloquear esta nomeado em blocking_inclusions, com a sua rota.

PreToolUse/check_config_protection.py._comment: PLAN-124 WS-2 (ECC value-harvest) — adopter linter/formatter config protection, ADVISORY variant for the USER ceremony. Same hook as the maintainer ceremony but NON-BLOCKING: the top-level env sets CEO_CONFIG_PROTECTION_ADVISORY=1, so on an edit of an EXISTING adopter linter config the hook ALLOWS the tool call and attaches a systemMessage steer ('fix the code, not the config') instead of blocking. ALWAYS allows in Sprint 11 (State 0 advisory). CEO_BUDGET_BYPASS=1 is the Owner-only escape hatch (rate-limited 10/24h per plan per H13). Sprint 12 flip criterion documented in ADR-033 §2 Flip Criteria Table.

PostToolUse._comment: Silent audit-log observer (Python): appends one JSONL line per Agent spawn to $HOME/.claude/projects/<project>/audit-log.jsonl. Silent stdout composes with reminder hook. Schema: .claude/plans/AUDIT-LOG-SCHEMA.md. Python single-file with hook_duration_ms + monthly rotation at 10MB.

Confidence gate (Sprint 9 Phase 1, ADR-019): PostToolUse Agent hook that invokes confidence_gate.py CLI over agent output, emits confidence_gate audit event, and ENFORCES blocking when CEO_CONFIDENCE_ENFORCE=1 (Owner-only flip; see ADR-019 + RELEASE.md). Advisory-only by default. CEO_CONFIDENCE_BYPASS=1 is the session-scoped escape hatch. Fail-open on timeout/infra per CLAUDE.md §Critical Rules. 10s timeout covers the CLI's 5s subprocess + overhead.

Output safety (Sprint 11 Phase 9, ADR-036, H14): PostToolUse Agent hook that scans tool_response for PII/secrets via mandatory pipeline (NFKC → zero-width strip → base64 decode ≤1 → Shannon entropy → regex). Advisory Sprint 11 (flag mode); emits output_safety_flag audit event, output preserved. CEO_OUTPUT_SAFETY_MODE=redact switches to [REDACTED:TYPE] substitution. CEO_SOTA_DISABLE=1 short-circuits to allow no-op. Sprint 12 flag→redact flip criterion in ADR-036.
After any Agent spawn, remind CEO to verify the agent respected the file assignment.
